name: Quickpay Funding
summary: Owner-operator factoring with same-day funding, including weekends and holidays, and 24/7 fuel advances.
differentiator: Funds the same day even on weekends and holidays, where Bobtail and Thunder Funding state weekday cutoffs. No minimum invoice amount or volume, so a carrier can factor a single small load.

terms.advance: Up to 98% of the invoice within 24 hours
terms.minimum: No monthly minimums, no minimum invoice amount or volume minimums
terms.speed: Same day, even on weekends and holidays
